Loss report: gitlab -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden, include) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (coverage) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends, interruptible, resource_group) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag (a job cannot trigger on a push and on a tag: the tag resource has no version on a branch push, so the job would never start; the job runs on push only)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the params of every task (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.retry: attempts on a do wrapper (the whole plan is retried; attempts counts the total tries)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/common job.retry: attempts on a do wrapper (the whole plan is retried; attempts counts the total tries)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/common/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod job.retry: attempts on a do wrapper (the whole plan is retried; attempts counts the total tries)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
